name: tpl-chain-response-1-goal
task: Carry the box to the exit. Whenever the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task's rule 'Whenever the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move' is missing entirely. The clauses contain only Existence(at_exit). The 'very next move' wording requires ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) (hard): after box_fell, holding_box must be true on the very next step — and since box_fell and holding_box never hold together, holding_box true on the next step exactly means the agent picked the box back up. Add that hard clause alongside Existence(at_exit).

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) requires reaching the exit and Response(at_exit, holding_box) expresses carrying the box there (holding it on that step), while ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) makes the box be in the hands on the very next step after each fall, matching 'pick it up again on your very next move'.
